sources.title: UK hydrogen strategy
sources.role: Government strategy for development of the UK low-carbon hydrogen economy
sources.facts: Sets the strategic policy context for hydrogen production, demand, networks and industrial decarbonisation.
sources.guard: Strategic ambition does not prove a named project's eligibility, funding, emissions performance, consent or delivery.

sources.title: Hydrogen infrastructure strategic planning: policy statement
sources.role: Policy statement on strategic planning of hydrogen transport and storage infrastructure
sources.facts: Describes intended strategic planning roles and the relationship with future transport and storage business-model allocations.
sources.guard: Strategic network planning does not reserve a route, connection, storage volume, funding award or planning consent.

sources.title: Hydrogen production delivery roadmap
sources.role: Government roadmap for hydrogen production deployment and allocation milestones
sources.facts: Sets out policy milestones and the intended progression of hydrogen allocation rounds and production support.
sources.guard: A roadmap milestone is not evidence that an allocation round, contract award, construction or operation occurred for a particular project.

sources.title: Hydrogen Allocation Rounds
sources.role: Official collection for hydrogen production allocation rounds
sources.facts: Collects eligibility, application, shortlist and award information for supported low-carbon hydrogen production rounds.
sources.guard: Application or shortlist status is not a contract award, financial close, planning consent or operational production.

sources.title: UK Low Carbon Hydrogen Standard
sources.role: Government emissions and sustainability standard for low-carbon hydrogen
sources.facts: Includes version 4 published in January 2026 and methodology for emissions reporting and sustainability criteria.
sources.guard: The standard does not certify a project unless its evidence is assessed under the applicable scheme; it is not planning or environmental consent.

sources.title: Carbon capture, usage and storage business models
sources.role: Official collection of CCUS transport, storage, power and industrial capture commercial frameworks
sources.facts: Updated 22 July 2026 with Transition Access Agreement policy material and commercial principles.
sources.guard: A proposed commercial framework or template does not prove access, allocated capacity, signed contract, financing, permit or operation.

sources.title: Clean flexibility roadmap
sources.role: July 2026 roadmap for low-carbon flexibility, hydrogen and storage actions
sources.facts: Sets out planned actions, including intended 2026 transport and storage allocation activity and hydrogen support milestones.
sources.guard: Planned actions are not completed allocations, grid connections, construction or service availability.

sources.title: Clean Energy Industries Sector Plan
sources.role: Government sector plan for clean-energy industry growth and investment
sources.facts: Describes policy ambitions for hydrogen, CCUS and other clean-energy industries, investment and jobs.
sources.origin: Department for Business and Trade / DESNZ / GOV.UK
sources.guard: Sector-level investment or jobs expectations do not prove site-specific demand, award, employment, consent or viability.
